name: NEO-M9N GPS breakout
description: u-blox NEO-M9N 92-channel GNSS receiver (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou concurrently, about 1.5 m accuracy) that streams NMEA sentences (position, altitude, speed, UTC time) over its UART at 38400 baud 8N1, once per second by default. The chip runs on 2.7-3.6 V; the breakout also has a 5V pin feeding an on-board 3.3 V regulator, a rechargeable backup battery, Qwiic (I2C) and USB-C connectors. The 7-pin top header is modelled; the opposite edge carries PPS, RST, SAFE, INT and a second GND/3V3/SDA/SCL row (optional). Sold as: SparkFun GPS Breakout - NEO-M9N, U.FL (Qwiic), GPS-15712 (also GPS-15733 chip antenna, GPS-17285 SMA; same headers), top header GND, 5V, 3V3, CS, RX/MOSI, TX/MISO, SCK.
eli5: Listens to four satellite systems at once and tells your board where on Earth it is, once a second.

pins.name: 5V
pins.description: Optional 5 V input (max 6 V) to the on-board 3.3 V regulator. Leave unconnected when the 3V3 pin is powered (use one supply input, not both)

pins.name: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V supply straight to the NEO-M9N VCC (2.7-3.6 V, absolute max 3.6 V). Feed it from the board's 3V3 pin

pins.name: CS
pins.description: SPI chip select when the D_SEL jumper is closed; I2C SDA (Qwiic) otherwise. Not needed for UART use

pins.name: RX/MOSI
pins.description: Module UART input (3.3 V logic, max 3.6 V): connect to the board's UART TX. Only needed to send UBX/NMEA configuration

pins.name: TX/MISO
pins.description: Module UART output, NMEA at 38400 baud 8N1, 3.3 V logic: connect to the board's UART RX

pins.name: SCK
pins.description: SPI clock when the D_SEL jumper is closed; I2C SCL (Qwiic) otherwise. Not needed for UART use

buildNotes: Cross the serial lines: module TX/MISO goes to the board's UART RX pin, module RX/MOSI (optional) to the board's UART TX pin.
The factory default is 38400 baud, 8N1 (not 9600 like older NEO-6M/M8N modules); open the UART at 38400 or the sentences come out as garbage.
Power it from the 3V3 pin (2.7-3.6 V) or from the 5V pin (max 6 V, on-board regulator), not both. The I/O is 3.3 V only, so wire ESP32/Pico pins directly but never a 5 V UART.
Leave the D_SEL jumper open: open means UART + I2C, closed switches the header to SPI and the UART stops working.
With several constellations the position sentences start $GNGGA / $GNRMC, not $GPGGA; match the sentence type after the talker ID.
Connect an active or passive GNSS antenna to the U.FL socket (the GPS-15733 has a chip antenna) and give it a view of the sky. Cold start is about 24 s outdoors; indoors it may never get a fix.
Peak supply current is up to 100 mA during acquisition; supply it from the board's 3V3 pin, never a GPIO.

driver.code:
# u-blox NEO-M9N GNSS receiver (SparkFun GPS Breakout NEO-M9N), MicroPython NMEA driver for the UART.
# NEO-M9N-00B datasheet (UBX-19014285) 5.5 "Default interface settings": UART 38400 baud, 8N1,
# output NMEA GGA, GLL, GSA, GSV, RMC, VTG, TXT (no UBX), 1 Hz navigation.
# The receiver tracks GPS + GLONASS + Galileo + BeiDou concurrently, so combined position sentences
# use the talker ID "GN" ($GNGGA, $GNRMC); this driver accepts any talker ID.
# Every sentence is checked with its NMEA checksum (XOR of all characters between '$' and '*').
# Latitude is ddmm.mmmmm, longitude dddmm.mmmmm (u-blox M9 interface description, NMEA GGA / RMC).


def _checksum_ok(line):
    # line: str without CR/LF, starting with '$'
    star = line.rfind('*')
    if line[:1] != '$' or star < 0 or len(line) < star + 3:
        return False
    cs = 0
    for c in line[1:star]:
        cs ^= ord(c)
    try:
        return cs == int(line[star + 1:star + 3], 16)
    except ValueError:
        return False


def _deg(field, hemi, dlen):
    # 'ddmm.mmmmm' (dlen=2) or 'dddmm.mmmmm' (dlen=3) -> signed decimal degrees, None if empty
    if not field or not hemi:
        return None
    d = int(field[:dlen]) + float(field[dlen:]) / 60
    return -d if hemi in ('S', 'W') else d


def _num(field):
    return float(field) if field else None


class NEOM9N:
    def __init__(self, uart):
        """uart: machine.UART at 38400 baud (factory default), rx= the pin wired to the module's TX/MISO."""
        self.uart = uart
        self._buf = b''
        self.fix = False          # True when GGA quality > 0 or RMC status 'A'
        self.fix_quality = 0      # GGA: 0 none, 1 GNSS fix, 2 DGNSS, 6 dead reckoning
        self.latitude = None      # decimal degrees, + north
        self.longitude = None     # decimal degrees, + east
        self.altitude = None      # metres above mean sea level (GGA)
        self.satellites = 0       # satellites used (GGA)
        self.hdop = None
        self.speed_knots = None   # speed over ground (RMC)
        self.course = None        # course over ground, degrees (RMC)
        self.utc_time = None      # (hh, mm, ss)
        self.date = None          # (day, month, 2-digit year)
        self.bad_checksums = 0

    def update(self):
        """Read what has arrived and decode complete sentences. Returns True if a GGA or RMC was decoded."""
        n = self.uart.any()
        if n:
            data = self.uart.read(n)
            if data:
                self._buf += data
        got = False
        while True:
            nl = self._buf.find(b'\n')
            if nl < 0:
                break
            line = self._buf[:nl].strip()
            self._buf = self._buf[nl + 1:]
            try:
                line = line.decode()
            except UnicodeError:  # noise or a binary UBX frame
                continue
            try:
                if line and self._parse(line):
                    got = True
            except (ValueError, IndexError):  # malformed field
                pass
        if len(self._buf) > 1024:  # garbage without newlines (wrong baud rate?)
            self._buf = b''
        return got

    def _parse(self, line):
        if line[:1] != '$':
            return False
        if not _checksum_ok(line):
            self.bad_checksums += 1
            return False
        f = line[1:line.rfind('*')].split(',')
        kind = f[0][2:]  # skip the talker ID (GN, GP, GL, GA, GB)
        if kind == 'GGA' and len(f) >= 10:
            self._time(f[1])
            self.fix_quality = int(f[6]) if f[6] else 0
            self.fix = self.fix_quality > 0
            self.satellites = int(f[7]) if f[7] else 0
            self.hdop = _num(f[8])
            if self.fix:
                self.latitude = _deg(f[2], f[3], 2)
                self.longitude = _deg(f[4], f[5], 3)
                self.altitude = _num(f[9])
            return True
        if kind == 'RMC' and len(f) >= 10:
            self._time(f[1])
            self.fix = f[2] == 'A'
            if self.fix:
                self.latitude = _deg(f[3], f[4], 2)
                self.longitude = _deg(f[5], f[6], 3)
                self.speed_knots = _num(f[7])
                self.course = _num(f[8])
            if len(f[9]) == 6:
                self.date = (int(f[9][0:2]), int(f[9][2:4]), int(f[9][4:6]))
            return True
        return False

    def _time(self, t):
        if len(t) >= 6:
            self.utc_time = (int(t[0:2]), int(t[2:4]), int(float(t[4:])))
